task: Close the remaining self-knowledge friction before further template production: make Atlas import extraction syntax-aware, restore Catalog domain coverage, and reconcile canonical versus development Failure Intake in Sentinel without weakening durable intake.
notes: Product Owner requested this hardening before returning to template production. No new parallel gate. Atlas must stop treating string assertions as imports; DOMAIN-CATALOG must cover the real canonical catalog files; Sentinel must separate canonical/main unresolved Failure Intake from development/PR intake so branch iteration cannot masquerade as platform instability. Sentinel remains observation-only and durable Failure Intake is not deleted or weakened. Final closure also adds deterministic Failure Intake reconciliation to the existing periodic full-replay authority: duplicate/promoted/resolved-by-later-success evidence is explicitly dispositioned and closed; unknown or still-active evidence remains open. No issue is silently deleted and Sentinel remains observation-only. Plan scope expanded explicitly because the existing Knowledge Full Replay workflow is Release authority; this is a planned integration, not an unreviewed scope leak.
